name: Eclipse Ritual

start.dialog: Sun speaks: Light waxes strong! / Moon whispers: But shadow wanes! / Together: The balance must be restored! Bring us Sunpetals from the heights and Moondew from the depths!
start.objective: Collect 5 Sunpetals from high peaks and 5 Moondew from deep caves

progress.dialog: Sun: The light ingredients! / Moon: The dark ingredients! / Together: Both are needed! Balance!
progress.objective: Gather the remaining items for the ritual

complete.dialog: Sun: Perfect! The warmth! / Moon: Perfect! The coolness! / Together: Balance restored! Take this Eclipse Charm! It holds both powers! Use in times of need!

party_comments.kade: Two voices, one body. Must be confusing at breakfast.
party_comments.renna: They channel both Light and Shadow Foundations. Remarkable.
party_comments.vex: Balance is the key to all things. They understand this.

hidden_outcome: If you bring the items during an actual eclipse (specific game time), they perform a ritual that permanently increases your Light and Shadow resistance
